description:

- Built for long-term bathroom use: crafted of solid brass materials for durability
- Fit that matches standard rods: made for use with any 1-inch diameter shower rod
- Coordinate your space: part of the shower curtain rod brackets collection for a cohesive, transitional bathroom hardware look

- Shipping weight: 2 lbs.

- Assembly: assembled in the USA
